newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Premiere climbs 3.31 pct, most active issue.
newsitem.headline: Premiere climbs 3.31 pct, most active issue.

text.p: Premiere Entertainment Productions Inc, the Philippines' only publicly-listed movie producer, rose eight centavos, or 3.31 percent, to 2.50 pesos, in late Thursday trade, brokers said.
Premiere reached an intra-day high of 2.65 pesos earlier in the session.
"In a market like this, people just latch on to any stock that moves. It's just a trading play. ," said Allan Araullo, vice-president at Regina Capital Development Corp.
"I do not see any fundamental reason for the issue to come up as fast as it did so I think it's just a play," said Juanis Barredo, analyst at Citisecurities Inc.
Premiere emerged as the most actively traded issue in late session with turnover at 141.97 million pesos.
